non-exhaustive list

Reasons I love you (best-friend edition)

1

You remember the tiny details about people's lives that even they forget.

2

You show up. Every time, no matter how far or how inconvenient.

3

You laugh with your whole body and it's genuinely contagious.

4

You tell me the truth, even when it's easier not to.

5

You make ordinary days feel like an event just by being there.

6

You've never once made me feel like too much.

Tsi,

I don't say this enough, so I'm saying it in code instead: I love you. Not in a complicated way — in the simplest, most sisterly, "you're stuck with me forever" kind of way. You've been one of the steadiest, kindest, funniest people in my life, and I don't take that for granted.

I hope this year gives you everything you deserve and nothing you don't. I hope people finally learn to keep up with your energy. And I hope you know, today and every day, how loved you are.

Happy birthday, Rapunzel. Here's to another year of your ridiculous hair and your even more ridiculous heart.

— Ermi 💛

I'll be honest about something, since it's your birthday and honesty feels like the right gift.

I've had feelings for you that went past friendship, and at one point I asked if you'd want to be more than that. You said no — and I want you to know that's completely okay. I asked you a question, you answered it, and that's the end of it. I'm not writing this hoping it changes anything.

What I actually want is for none of that to take anything away from us. You're still my best friend, full stop, and that matters to me more than the other thing ever did. I just didn't want to carry it around quietly forever when you're someone I tell things to.

— Ermi
